patient_identity.statement: Packet proband maps to the present male case, who died aged three months; it is distinct from the Bouman 2018 comparison case.

evidence.locator: Clinical Report L105–L124; Table 1 L168–L222, present-case column

genotype.statement: Main text reports homozygous DMRT2 NM_181872.6:c.129delC, p.(Asp43fs*75), hg38 chr9:1051741 AC>A. The packet describes the corresponding deletion but expands HGVS protein/reference accessions beyond the printed notation.

evidence.locator: Results L126–L142; Figure 1 caption L156–L158; Table 1 L221–L222

limitations: NP_870987.2:p.(Asp43GlufsTer75) and NC_000009.12:g.1051742del are not independently transcript-normalized here; predicted protein consequence is not measured function.

segregation.statement: Parents are reported consanguineous, but no parental samples were available; familial segregation was not tested.
limitations: Do not infer parental carrier status or a demonstrated Mendelian segregation from consanguinity.

phase.statement: Homozygous/biallelic assignment is supported by read-depth presence of both gene copies and the surrounding approximately 3.5 Mb run of homozygosity.
limitations: No parental phasing; this is the authors' inference from singleton exome data, not an independent read-data audit.

causal_confidence.statement: Packet PATHOGENIC differs from the explicit likely pathogenic classification (PVS1,PM2,PP4), also TableS1 I5. Hypothesized thymic/immunodeficiency extension remains unproven.
limitations: Corrects the prior main-text-only checkpoint, which noted likely pathogenic but did not explicitly flag the packet formal-label mismatch. TableS1 alternative variants do not establish exclusion of every possible cause.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All28 features reviewed with all supplements. ASD remains unsupported; bilateral cleft laterality is unreported, and absent T cells overstates a measurable low fraction. Packet omits thymic aplasia, B/NK expansion, digit/foot details and interventions.
limitations: Source silence about ASD is not an explicit negative examination.

assessment.statement: Gene, homozygosity, transcript c.129 deletion, predicted frameshift and anchored hg38 VCF chr9:1051741 AC>A correspond to the main report.
